attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a router between its two segments: eth1 (172.20.1.0/24, peered with node2's enp8s0) and eth2 (172.20.2.0/24, peered with node3's enp8s0), with IPv4 forwarding enabled and docker0's class-E leak neutralized. Persisted this via a systemd oneshot service (antrieb-segments.service) plus /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf on node1, and via systemd-networkd static .network overrides on node2/node3 (enp8s0 static address + route, taking precedence over the existing en* DHCP catch-all). Verified node2<->node3 reachability through node1 both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time; each node's boot_id changed and its addressing/forwarding/routing/connectivity recovered automatically without manual intervention.
